# Halcyon HX-2 portable fluid pump: Nonconformance and Deviation Reporting

## 1 Scope
This fictional training SOP records observed HX-2 product or tool nonconformance. A deviation record captures an observation; it does not authorize a process change or release. All names, parts, limits, and records are synthetic demo data.

## 2 Required record fields
| Field | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Affected item | Pump serial number or tool asset number |
| Procedure context | SOP identifier, revision, and section when known |
| Observation | Actual condition and measured value with its unit |
| Containment | Location and HOLD tag number |

## 3 Warning
> WARNING: Stop the affected operation. Do not repair, retorque, discard, or release the item while awaiting review. A successful alert is not approval to continue. The stored deviation record is the compliance artifact.

## 4 Procedure
### 4.1 Stop and contain
1. Stop the affected operation and disconnect pump power when applicable. Attach a red HOLD tag and move the item to quarantine shelf Q2. Keep associated parts together and record the HOLD tag number.

### 4.2 Record the observation
2. State the pump serial number or tool asset number, procedure revision and section, observed condition, and measured value with its unit. Record facts only. Do not guess the cause or change a reading to match a limit.

### 4.3 Save the deviation
3. Submit the observation to the deviation log and retain the returned DEV identifier. Confirm that the record was saved before leaving station Q2. If saving fails, keep the item on HOLD and contact the supervisor directly.

### 4.4 Notify the supervisor
4. Notify the training supervisor within 10 min after saving the record. If the automatic alert fails, give the supervisor the DEV identifier directly and keep the item on HOLD. An alert failure does not invalidate a saved deviation.

### 4.5 Await disposition
5. Keep the item on quarantine shelf Q2 until the training supervisor enters a written disposition against the DEV identifier. Only the designated release inspector may remove the HOLD tag after that disposition is complete.

## 5 Records
Retain the deviation text, procedure context, timestamp, and notification status. Do not attach raw audio. This procedure gives no automatic acceptance, rework torque, or concession limits.
